component.name: Aurémi
component.summary: Install and integrate AppImages with a double-click
Installer et intégrer des AppImage par un double-clic

description.p: Aurémi turns downloaded AppImages into properly integrated Linux desktop applications without requiring terminal commands.
Aurémi transforme les AppImage téléchargées en applications Linux correctement intégrées, sans nécessiter de commandes dans un terminal.

ul.li: Adds applications to the application menu and desktop
Extracts names and icons without launching the AppImage
Supports AMD64 and ARM64 Linux systems

description.p: Makes English the default language for all commands, errors, notifications, and generated metadata.
